title: Keeping the shelves selling during a busy day
target: How to keep product on the sales floor while customers are in the shop, using the shelf and pricing behaviour the game defines.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Priced stock ready to go out
More than one shelf kind available

steps.do: Check which shelf kind a product belongs on before you restock.
steps.because: the game separates plain shelves, card shelves and combination shelves (CardShelf, CardItemCombiShelf, Shelf)

steps.do: Restock from the shelf manager view rather than walking the room blind.
steps.because: shelf contents are tracked by a manager (ShelfManager)

steps.do: Keep priced stock in reserve so a gap can be filled immediately.
steps.because: a card's price is applied through a price tag object, so an unpriced card cannot simply be shelved (InteractableCardPriceTag)

steps.do: Keep boxes where you can reach them, because packaging is physical.
steps.because: packaging boxes exist separately for cards, items and shelves (InteractablePackagingBox_Card, InteractablePackagingBox_Shelf)

commonMistakes: Leaving a shelf empty while customers are inside.
Putting cards on the wrong kind of shelf.
Keeping all your stock in sealed boxes and none on the floor.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
